verdict.rationale: Llama is an instruction-tuned model family, so its core use is natural-language prompting. The evidence supports this through instruct models, function calling and agent-optimized inference (llama-docs-2, llama-docs-16), a 'multi-agent coding in your terminal' claim (llama-docs-12), and hands-on chat UI and playground use (llama-comm-13, llama-comm-4). Operating the product itself (listing, downloading and verifying models) is done through flag-based `llama-model` CLI commands, not natural language. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's own tooling, documented detail on the terminal agent experience, and publicly readable docs (llama-supp-docs-gated shows them behind a login).
